content_sections.heading: About the Library
content_sections.text: The Shreenivas Deshpande Library is the library of the Indian Institute of Technology (BHU) in Varanasi. The notice, dated 17 November 2026 and titled "Vacancy for Library Professional Trainees 2026-27", invites young, dynamic, tech-savvy, highly motivated and committed Post-Graduates in Library and Information Science from recognized Indian universities with a consistently good academic record.

content_sections.heading: Seats by Trade
content_sections.text: The notice announces one assignment and does not divide the seats by trade, unit or category.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The educational qualification is First Class in Masters in Library and Information Science or equivalent from a recognized Institute/University having a good academic record. Candidates who have passed the final year M.L.I.Sc. examinations in 2025 and 2026 should only apply. Desirable: candidates with relevant Computer Knowledge will be preferred. The age limit is 27 years as on the last date of application. Relaxation in age for OBC, SC, ST and PBWD category candidates will be applicable as per Govt. of India rules. The notice does not print a category-wise break-up of the 13 positions or the amount of relaxation. For the full eligibility conditions, candidates should refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Stipend and Training Period
content_sections.text: The stipend is 25,000/- per month, consolidated, with no additional perks. The period of training is one year from the date of joining. The traineeship is described as purely temporary, and the positions will be deemed to be automatically terminated at the end of the completion of the tenure.

content_sections.heading: IIT (BHU) Library Professional Trainee Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice describes the nature of the traineeship as follows: Selected trainees will get an opportunity to work in various sections of the Library on emerging tools and technologies in the Library and Information Science field. They will have to work in different shifts (as applicable), including morning, evening and late-night shifts. They will also work on weekends/holidays on a rotational basis (six days a week). No accommodation facilities will be provided by IIT (BHU).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT (BHU) Library Professional Trainee
content_sections.text: Apply online on the portal https://recruite-trainee.iitbhu.ac.in/ by 30 November 2026. Submit the application fee of ₹500 along with the application, as the notice requires. The notice does not describe registration steps, the payment mode, or the documents and photo specifications to be uploaded.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice says that the Institute reserves the right to hold a written test and/or an interview in the selection process. The date for the written test/interview will be communicated to the shortlisted candidates through e-mail or published on the website. The Institute also reserves the right to place a reasonable limit on the total number of candidates to be called for an interview/recruitment exam.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the selection process. The Institute reserves the right to reject any or all applications without assigning any reason, and its decision is final and binding. Merely fulfilling the minimum qualification will not vest any right in a candidate to be called for a written test/skill test/interview. The Institute's decision on eligibility, written test/interview and selection is final and binding on all candidates. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.

faq.question: Q1. How many Library Professional Trainee positions are there at IIT (BHU)?
faq.answer: There are 13 (Thirteen) positions for Library Professional Trainee at the Shreenivas Deshpande Library, IIT (BHU), Varanasi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted through the online portal by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for IIT (BHU) Library Professional Trainee?
faq.answer: First Class in Masters in Library and Information Science or equivalent from a recognized Institute/University. Only candidates who passed the final year M.L.I.Sc. in 2025 and 2026 should apply.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 27 years as on the last date of application, with relaxation for OBC, SC, ST and PBWD candidates as per Govt. of India rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the stipend for the trainee?
faq.answer: The stipend is 25,000/- per month, consolidated, with no additional perks.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The notice states an application fee of ₹500, to be submitted along with the online application.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Submit the application online at https://recruite-trainee.iitbhu.ac.in/ by 30 November 2026, along with the ₹500 fee.

faq.question: Q8. How are trainees selected?
faq.answer: The Institute reserves the right to hold a written test and/or interview. Dates will be sent to shortlisted candidates by e-mail or published on the website.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. It is a purely temporary traineeship for one year from the date of joining, and the positions are deemed automatically terminated when the tenure ends.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA or accommodation be provided?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the selection process, and no accommodation facilities will be provided by IIT (BHU).
